segments.thag1.70:2.1: Vappo ca vajjiputto ca, pakkho vimalakoṇḍañño;

lines: Tattha sīlanti sīlanaṭṭhena sīlaṃ, patiṭṭhānaṭṭhena samādhānaṭṭhena cāti attho.
“sīle patiṭṭhāya naro sapañño”ti (saṃ. ni.1.23; peṭako.22; visuddhi.1.1).
Samādahati ca taṃ kāyavācāavippakiṇṇaṃ karotīti attho.
Tayidaṃ sīlameva aggaṃ sabbaguṇānaṃ mūlabhāvato pamukhabhāvato ca.
“tasmātiha, tvaṃ bhikkhu, ādimeva visodhehi kusalesu dhammesu.
Ko cādi kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ sīlañca suvisuddhan”ti (saṃ. ni.5.369),“pātimokkhanti mukhametaṃ pamukhametan”ti (mahāva.135) ca ādi.
So uttamo seṭṭho pavaroti puggalādhiṭṭhānāya gāthāya paññāyayeva seṭṭhabhāvaṃ dasseti.
Idāni taṃ sīlapaññānaṃ aggaseṭṭhabhāvaṃ kāraṇato dasseti “manussesu ca devesu, sīlapaññāṇato jayan”ti ca.
